payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source image, is there reliable visual evidence that the woman's jacket has moved toward closure while remaining not fully closed?
node.criteria: Pass only if reliable visual evidence establishes that the same jacket moved toward closure compared with the source and remains not fully closed. Use comparable views of the front opening or panel relationship when available, or other directly visible, reliable evidence that establishes this change. Fail only if reliable comparable evidence establishes no movement toward closure, no change, or a wider opening. Do not treat turning, viewpoint change, fabric flare or displacement, or motion alone as progress. Unknown if no reliable evidence establishes the change, including when the closure or its change cannot be discerned.
node.binding: Compare the same jacket in the source and edited images. Use comparable views of the front opening or panel relationship when available, and consider other directly visible, reliable evidence only if it establishes movement toward closure. Do not treat turning, viewpoint change, fabric flare or displacement, or motion alone as progress. This check records partial progress only and does not satisfy the full-closure requirement; retain unknown when evidence is insufficient.

node_traces.evidence: The source shows the woman mostly facing forward with the jacket opening visible, while the edited image shows her turned sideways and the jacket flaring outward. These are not comparable views of the front opening, and the apparent fabric displacement does not reliably establish movement toward closure. The edited jacket also cannot be reliably assessed as still partly open from this view.
